module_summary: Scatter-gather AXI DMA wrapper: an AXI-lite register bank starts an SG FSM that fetches table entries via a prefetch unit and programs an inner AXI DMA, with an arbiter merging prefetch and DMA read channels.

anchors.name: r_busy
anchors.why: Busy from SG FSM; gates all register writes, start, error and interrupt logic.

anchors.name: r_tbl_addr
anchors.why: Scatter-gather table base address, written over AXI-lite and updated by FSM while busy.

anchors.name: pf_wins_arbitration
anchors.why: Grant selecting prefetch or DMA read requests onto the shared AR channel.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: AXI master read data shared by DMA engine and table prefetcher.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: AXI master write data produced by the inner DMA engine.

anchors.name: r_start
anchors.why: Start pulse from control register write, kicks off the SG FSM.

anchors.name: r_abort
anchors.why: Abort flag set by ABORT_KEY write while busy; aborts FSM and blocks start.

anchors.name: r_err
anchors.why: Sticky error bit from FSM error, readable in control register.

anchors.name: o_int
anchors.why: Interrupt output raised on FSM interrupt when enabled and busy.

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite write accept enabling control/table register updates and BVALID.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: Control/status and table-address readback mux register.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Arbitrated AXI read address from prefetch or DMA through output skid buffer.

anchors.name: dmac_wvalid
anchors.why: FSM write valid programming the inner DMA control registers.

anchors.name: pf_valid
anchors.why: Prefetch word valid delivering table entries to the SG FSM.

anchors.name: pf_insn
anchors.why: Table entry word fetched by prefetcher, consumed by FSM.

anchors.name: dmac_wdata
anchors.why: Descriptor word written by FSM into inner DMA registers.

anchors.name: new_pc
anchors.why: FSM request restarting prefetch at a new table address.

anchors.name: pf_ready
anchors.why: FSM ready accepting prefetch words.

anchors.name: dma_complete
anchors.why: Inner DMA completion interrupt fed back to the SG FSM.

anchors.name: r_int_enable
anchors.why: Interrupt enable bit gating o_int.

anchors.name: r_int
anchors.why: Sticky interrupt status bit, cleared by control write.

anchors.name: r_qos
anchors.why: QoS field programmed via control register, passed to FSM.

anchors.name: r_prot
anchors.why: AXI protection field programmed via control register, passed to FSM.

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: Write register address selecting control or table-address register.

anchors.name: wskd_data
anchors.why: Skid-buffered AXI-lite write data for register updates.

anchors.name: axil_read_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite read accept advancing RVALID and readback.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write response valid.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read data valid.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Arbitrated read request valid into output skid buffer.

anchors.name: pf_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Prefetcher read request competing for AR channel.

anchors.name: sdma_arvalid
anchors.why: Inner DMA read request competing for AR channel.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write burst address valid from inner DMA.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid steered by RID to DMA or prefetcher.

groups.name: AXI-lite control register bank
groups.description: Skid-buffered AXI-lite slave holding start/abort/error/interrupt bits and table address.

groups.name: Scatter-gather sequencer
groups.description: SG FSM reads table entries and programs inner DMA registers, reporting busy/error/interrupt.

groups.name: Table prefetcher
groups.description: AXI fetch unit reading descriptor words from memory for the SG FSM.

groups.name: Inner DMA engine
groups.description: AXI DMA moving data with read bursts into FIFO and write bursts out.

groups.name: AR channel arbiter
groups.description: Arbitrates prefetch vs DMA read requests and muxes onto the skid-buffered AR channel.
